newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SEPAP CANCELS CONTRACT WITH EBRD FOR LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SEPAP CANCELS CONTRACT WITH EBRD FOR LOAN.

text.p: Czech paper maker Sepap a.s. has cancelled an agreement with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development to lead manage a 111 million mark loan, the Prague Stock Exchange's official bulletin said on Friday.
It added that it would now seek a new manager for the credit, which should be in the "region of 100 million marks".
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. The bulletin gave no further details.
Swedish forestry group AssiDoman holds a 39 percent stake in Sepap.
